source.changes: Source facts paraphrased into decision scopes; implementation/evidence reconciliation and tracker ownership are Edda additions. No runtime grants.

common_acceptance: For this one PR, preview is inert; explicit confirmation revalidates authoritative eligibility, source/version, target facts and expected revision. Persist choice, exact dice, once-only cost/use and history atomically. Receipt replay/retry/reload returns the same result without rerolling or charging again. Inject history failure for full rollback; race two confirmations and require one commit; stale/foreign/unsupported state rejects without mutation. Prove this with deterministic dice and isolated PostgreSQL handler/state fixtures. Disclose only player-known targets, choices, costs and source derivations; hidden/foreign facts never enter previews, receipts or errors. Shared engine serves web and TUI: explicitly expose supported choices or show unavailable with a reason on both; require desktop/phone confirmation and reconnect plus TUI behavior fixtures before availability. No Full Rules/coverage promotion. Higher-level isolated fixture state never grants production entitlement. Run GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -short -race ./... and go vet -p 2 ./...; changed UI requires build, focused lint and behavior tests.

issues.title: Validate durable source-linked feat selections without granting class eligibility
issues.fixture: One atomic feat selection from an authoritative grant: exact category, prerequisites, repeatability and choices. A prerequisite naming a class requires at least one level in it; exceptions require a named source feature, never a client bypass. Unspecified category permits any category only when prerequisites hold. Existing legacy Alert and Magic Initiate names must not alias SRD identities.
issues.positive: Accept one eligible grant and reject replay double selection; allow only Skilled/ASI repeats and Magic Initiate different lists.
issues.negative: Reject unknown key, wrong category, missing Fighting Style/Spellcasting feature, unmet level/ability, repeated nonrepeatable feat, forged grant or unsupported production class. No class unlock from catalogue or fixture flag.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Alert with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Add optional PB at initiative and exchange with one willing ally immediately after rolling; neither participant may be Incapacitated and both must be in the same combat.
issues.positive: PB=3 adds 3, then swap exact initiatives with willing ally.
issues.negative: Reject late swap, unwilling/foreign ally and either incapacitated participant; never use legacy +5/no-surprise rule.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Magic Initiate with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Choose Cleric/Druid/Wizard list, INT/WIS/CHA, two cantrips and one level-one spell from that list; always prepared. Each repeat uses a different list. At each new level optionally replace one chosen spell with same-level spell on same list. Preserve independent free use per selection, recovered only on completed Long Rest, and owned-slot routing. Spell execution stays with #264/#265/#277 and routing #273.
issues.positive: Select Wizard/INT then Cleric/WIS; replace one cantrip on level gain and preserve each list free use.
issues.negative: Reject repeated list, wrong-level/list spell, second replacement at same level and invented slot/free use. Unknown spell execution stays unavailable.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Savage Attacker with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: On weapon hit optionally roll only weapon damage dice twice and choose either whole roll, once per turn; preserve modifiers and separately sourced extra damage.
issues.positive: With weapon rolls 2 and 6 select 2 or 6 and spend one turn use.
issues.negative: Miss, nonweapon damage and second same-turn use reject; no automatic best-of individual dice or double modifiers.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Skilled with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Each selection grants any combination of three skills/tools; repeatable. Preserve proficiency provenance and apply the proficiency bonus only once; no expertise invention.
issues.positive: Choose two skills and a tool, then another valid repeat; resulting checks use each proficiency once.
issues.negative: Reject fewer/more than three, unknown proficiency and duplicate bonus stacking.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Ability Score Improvement with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: At level4+ choose one score +2 or two distinct scores +1, maximum20; repeatable. Shared ASI application also supports Grappler STR/DEX+1 cap20 and boon+1 cap30 with exact allowed abilities. Recompute derived modifiers/saves/attacks and Constitution HP retroactively (p23); retain grant identity, never heal or invent a level.
issues.positive: 18->20 or 19/19->20/20; boon29->30; Constitution modifier change updates maximum HP for prior levels.
issues.negative: Reject20->21 by ordinary ASI, boon30->31, wrong ability, missing level/grant, split +2 across same ability and retry double increase.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Grappler with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level4+ and STR or DEX13+; STR/DEX+1 cap20. On own-turn Attack-action Unarmed Strike hit, Damage+Grapple once per turn; advantage against a creature Grappled by you; no extra movement to move own grappled creature of own size or smaller. Shared condition/movement remains #270.
issues.positive: Qualify with DEX13, apply STR+1, then hit, damage+grapple once; move same-size target at ordinary cost and attack with advantage.
issues.negative: Reject level3, both abilities12, second punch/grab, off-turn/non-Attack-action trigger; other grappler grants no advantage, larger target retains extra movement.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Archery with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Fighting Style feature prerequisite; +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons, no other rolls.
issues.negative: Melee or ranged spell attack receives0.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Defense with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Fighting Style feature prerequisite; +1 AC wearing Light/Medium/Heavy armor. Extend existing fixed chain-mail fixture without double counting.
issues.positive: Each armor category adds1; removing armor removes1 and shield stays independent.
issues.negative: Shield alone/unarmored adds0; replay/equipment refresh never stacks extra Defense.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Great Weapon Fighting with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Fighting Style feature prerequisite; attack with Melee weapon held in two hands and Two-Handed or Versatile property: treat any1/2 on a damage die as3. Resolve once on dice with provenance, including Savage Attacker interaction.
issues.positive: Two-handed Versatile qualifying attack dice1,2,4 become3,3,4 and modifier unchanged.
issues.negative: One hand, ranged weapon or absent property leaves dice unchanged; no reroll or repeat conversion.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Two-Weapon Fighting with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Fighting Style feature prerequisite; add ability modifier to extra attack from Light-property weapon only if not already added.
issues.positive: Light extra attack receives positive modifier exactly once; retain existing negative modifier behavior.
issues.negative: Non-Light trigger or already-added modifier gets no extra addition; no extra attack entitlement.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Combat Prowess with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, any ability+1 cap30; optionally turn missed attack into hit, one use until start of next turn.
issues.positive: Miss becomes hit, persists use, next own turn refreshes.
issues.negative: Reject second use, already-hit trigger and round boundary without own-turn start.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Dimensional Travel with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, any ability+1 cap30; immediately after Attack or Magic action teleport up to30ft to visible unoccupied space.
issues.positive: After Attack teleport30ft to known empty visible location.
issues.negative: Reject31ft, occupied/unseen/unknown destination, wrong action or expired trigger; no opportunity-attack walking substitution.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Fate with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, any ability+1 cap30; after self/other within60ft succeeds/fails D20 Test optionally roll2d4 as bonus or penalty; one use until roll Initiative or finish Short/Long Rest.
issues.positive: Within60ft successful test takes penalty from fixed2d4; refresh at initiative or completed rest.
issues.negative: Reject61ft, second use, interrupted rest refresh and non-D20 event; no invented Reaction cost.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Irresistible Offense with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, STR/DEX+1 cap30; own Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing damage ignores Resistance, not Immunity. On attack d20=20 optionally extra damage equal to ability SCORE increased by feat, attack damage type.
issues.positive: STR25 makes optional25 typed extra damage on natural20; own BPS damage ignores Resistance, including BPS damage dealt by a spell.
issues.negative: Modified20 without d20=20 does not trigger; non-BPS Resistance and all Immunity remain; never substitute ability modifier.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Spell Recall with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+ and Spellcasting feature, INT/WIS/CHA+1 cap30. Each cast using slot1-4 rolls1d4; equal to slot level retains slot, else expend. Shared slot/cast authority belongs #273 and spells #277.
issues.positive: Slot3/d4=3 retains slot, d4=2 spends once; persist both dice/cast receipt.
issues.negative: Slots5+, cantrip, item/free casting get no refund roll; missing Spellcasting rejects feat even with Magic Initiate.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of the Night Spirit with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, any ability+1 cap30. Dim Light/Darkness: Bonus Action grants Invisible; ends immediately after subsequent action/Bonus Action/Reaction. In those light conditions resist all damage except Psychic/Radiant. Shared Invisible #268, light #145.
issues.positive: Dim Light activation costs Bonus Action, later Reaction ends Invisible; Fire resisted while Psychic is not.
issues.negative: Bright Light/unknown light rejects activation and shadow resistance; no self-cancellation by activation transaction, no hidden-location disclosure.

issues.title: Resolve source-exact Boon of Truesight with durable deterministic fixtures
issues.fixture: Level19+, any ability+1 cap30; Truesight60ft using source glossary p190. Shared visibility #145 and condition semantics #268 own sensing; no omniscience.
issues.positive: Explicit known scene adjudication at60ft applies Truesight visual exceptions.
issues.negative: 61ft, unknown facts and opaque barriers do not disclose hidden lore or grant unlimited sight.
